title: At the End of the Day

pkg.confirmedTitle: At the End of the Day
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro – Piano Instrumental]
(soft flowing piano motif, gentle evening tone, 8–12 bars)

[Verse 1]
Outside the window, starlight starts to sway
The wind leans in with something soft to say
“Keep the story of today,” it whispers low
Before it slowly lets the daylight go

[Pre-Chorus]
A blurred moonlight fills the room
My quiet heart begins to breathe

[Chorus]
In this silent evening, I drift into a dream
At the end of the day, I find myself smiling
Every fleeting moment wraps around me
In the hush of night, I feel myself whole

[Verse 2]
Shadows stretch across the desk in lines
A cooling teacup resting in my hands
Traces of the day remain right here
Settled gently in the air

[Piano Solo – Emotional Development]
(expressive flowing piano, reflective melodic variation, no vocal)

[Bridge]
Time does not have to stand still tonight
It’s alright if my heart walks slow
I let this quiet moment linger
Like something I don’t need to hold

[Chorus – soft repeat]
In this silent evening, I drift into a dream
At the end of the day, I find myself smiling
Every passing second holds me lightly
In the quiet dark, I am at ease

[Outro – Piano Instrumental]
(minimal piano reprise of chorus motif, fading naturally)
